company.name: Fleek
company.shortDescription: Fleek operates a B2B marketplace that connects retailers, online resellers, and vintage clothing wholesalers.
company.description: Fleek operates a business-to-business marketplace that connects retailers, online resellers, and vintage clothing wholesalers. The platform enables buyers to source wholesale second-hand fashion inventory from verified suppliers across multiple countries through online listings and live video buying sessions. It provides tools that support product discovery, order management, payments, shipping coordination, and buyer protection throughout the purchasing process. Fleek also performs quality inspections on inventory through its supply hubs and offers features that facilitate supplier matching and price negotiation. The platform serves businesses involved in the second-hand fashion industry by streamlining wholesale sourcing and cross-border transactions.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $25,000,000, or 54.4% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,085,590 to $185,575,341, a 30.49x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
